Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform.

 - Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams.

 - Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build.

 - Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use.

 - Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails.

 - Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior.

 - Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features.

 - Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping.

 - Strengthen our overall security engineering posture alongside the SRE team, contributing to our SOC 2 and compliance efforts (e.g. via Vanta), CI/CD security gates, and the principle that vulnerable code cannot get deployed.

 - Own our vulnerability management process: identify and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, drive remediation across engineering and platform teams, track findings to closure, and fix recurring findings at the root.

 - Strengthen identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption across our products and platform, including the credentials and access that agents and AI integrations depend on.

 - Establish detection, logging, and incident response practices for AI-specific threats, and help the team respond when they occur.

 - Stay ahead of a rapidly evolving threat landscape and continuously raise the bar for how we secure AI.

 - Promote secure development practices through developer guidance and trainings, awareness initiatives, and collaboration with engineering teams.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning security work end to end in production.

 - Strong grounding in application and cloud security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure design, common vulnerability classes, and secure SDLC practices.

 - Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Management.

 - Hands-on experience with identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption implementations.

 - Demonstrated interest and hands-on experience in AI/LLM security, whether through professional work, research, red teaming, CTFs, or personal projects, and familiarity with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS.

 - A proactive, builder mindset; you prevent problems by shipping guardrails and enabling teams, not just by finding issues.

 - Strong communication skills; able to explain AI-specific risks and tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and leadership.

ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

You will own the hardware and firmware decisions that determine how much intelligence we can put on the device and how reliably it works in difficult environments. These are full mobile computing devices with an application processor, cellular and Wi-Fi connectivity, sensors, a battery that lasts a full shift and clear two-way audio, all in wearable hardware that can withstand industrial use.  - Own circuit design and PCB development through working hardware.

 - Develop the low-level firmware that controls the device and keeps its real-time functions responsive.

Why this role matters:

As a Test Engineer, you will deliver software to defend Europe from space. Your scope covers the full verification stack: unit and integration test infrastructure, software-in-the-loop simulation of the Attitude and Orbit Control System (AOCS), hardware-in-the-loop test rigs running against real sensors and actuators, and the CI/CD pipelines that tie it all together. Your work is what allows us to perform software updates in orbit with confidence and short regular intervals while also protecting satellite availability. You will directly enhance customer satisfaction and enable ICEYE to execute most critical, value-generating

 

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

 

Your day-to-day responsibilities

 - Faster and safer AOCS releases: Automated verification runs on every change, so the AOCS team gets trustworthy feedback in minutes. Release candidates are qualified and published through a repeatable pipeline, which means higher quality software reaches the fleet more frequently.

 - Defects found on the ground, not in orbit: Test coverage extends beyond nominal cases into the off-nominal scenarios: sensor dropouts and degraded measurements, actuator saturation, eclipse, etc. Failure modes are reproduced in simulation and on hardware benches before they can cost us orbits.

 - Test suite across product variants: Comprehensive test pipelines cover all ADCS generations for different satellite products and peripheral configurations. Engineers trust the test and release pipeline, and the test infrastructure scales with the number of satellite variants and software configurations we support.

 - Improved pipeline status monitoring: Test results, coverage, and AOCS performance metrics are published automatically and are easy to read. Release quality is shared transparently across the organization enabling data-driven decision-making for fleet wide release deployment.

 - Reusable hardware-in-the-loop capability: HIL rigs are treated as a product, not a one-off lab setup: automated, monitored, well documented, and available to the whole team rather than dependent on one person’s presence in the lab.

 

What we’re looking for

 

Must haves:

 - Proven experience building test automation for embedded, real-time, or otherwise reliability-critical software.

 - Strong practical coding skills in Python, plus the ability to read, debug, and extend C/C++ application software

 - Hands-on CI/CD experience: pipelines, build tooling, containerisation, artefact and test reporting, and the discipline to keep pipelines fast and green.

 - Experience testing software against simulators or hardware test benches, including comfort working in a lab with real hardware, interfaces, and instrumentation.

 - Sound test strategy judgement: knowing what belongs in a unit test, what needs software-in-the-loop simulation, and what genuinely requires hardware-in-the-loop.

 - Thinking from a first-principles mindset. Reproducing an in-orbit or on-bench anomaly is detective work, and you will need to tackle it in a systematic manner.

 

Nice to haves:

 - Analysis and visualisation of telemetry and test data.

 - Embedded Linux, cross-compilation, and remote target debugging.

 - Simulation and modelling toolchains, including Matlab/Simulink or model-in-the-loop test harnesses.

About us

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with the car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.



About the team

The Business Operations & Analytics team is the strategic and analytical horsepower behind our relentless growth in a highly competitive market and despite headwinds. They’re primarily ex-BCG, McKinsey, and Bain consultants. Every product vertical or critical initiative has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded — they own data analysis, insights & strategy, and drive our teams towards our next goal: reach 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.



In 2026, we launched 5 new products — home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance. We’re adding 1-2 BizOps and Analytics team members to drive impact in one of these key areas:

 - Growth — paid and organic marketing, market expansion, supply and distribution partnerships

 - Product — building 0-1 products, scaling existing products



Note: Our priority is finding the right people, we are flexible on job leveling/title.



About the role

You'll be embedded in a product team or a business unit that sits across products, and own the following:

 - Strategy: Define what business questions we should answer. Develop a hypothesis and next steps, prioritize, and create solutions with cross-functional partners.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Build: Scope, validate and pursue new levers to accelerate our business. This could be building new products, testing new growth channels, launching new partnerships, or finding new ways to apply AI/automation.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.



Why you will (or won't) like working here

 - No corporate fluff: We’re a team of insatiable learners and overachievers who care deeply about solving interesting problems and making a real impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or layers of approvals.

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.



Who you are

 - Structured thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner/driver: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane. You’re a driver, not a passenger.



What you bring

 - 2+ years of experience in management/strategy consulting, venture capital, or high-growth startup environment.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.



Our tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.



Not necessary to have experience with the specific tech listed above. Thinking ability matters more to us than technical proficiency with any particular tool/language.



Compensation

This position offers base salary and stock options. The base salary for this position within New York and San Francisco is $140,000—160,000 USD, but we can be flexible based on your prior experience, leveling and location. We also offer comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with 4% employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others.



Location

We support remote work from AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, and Ontario, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in New York City, Palo Alto, Chicago, and Toronto. We also spend a week together as a company twice a year.

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Senior AI Marketing Enablement Manager to join the Demand Generation team.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=23.




THE TEAM

The Demand Generation team helps Jobber reach and engage small home service businesses through scalable marketing programs. We partner closely with Brand, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales, Data, and Product teams to create campaigns and experiences that drive awareness, pipeline, conversion, and customer growth.

This role will sit within Demand Generation and act as a force multiplier for the marketing organization. You’ll help marketers turn ideas into execution faster, reduce repetitive work, and develop new AI-enabled ways of planning, launching, analyzing, and optimizing campaigns.




THE ROLE

This is a senior individual contributor role with full ownership of Jobber's marketing AI capability. You'll step into an in-flight enablement program, including a library of tools, agents, MCP integrations, prompts, evals, documentation, and a partially enabled team, and you'll become the internal owner accountable for its reliability, its roadmap, and its adoption. There is no one above you doing this work; you set the standards, make the build-versus-sunset calls, and define how AI becomes part of how marketing operates at Jobber.

You'll work alongside our external enablement partner to take the program further, and you'll build hands-on yourself. You'll partner with marketers across campaign strategy, lifecycle, paid acquisition, SEO, GEO/AEO, content, CRO, marketing operations, and analytics, and coach them from first win to self-sufficiency. Because this field moves fast, you'll keep our approach current as models, tools, and best practices evolve, and you'll be the person leadership turns to for what's possible and what's worth doing.

The ambition goes beyond doing today's work faster. We want AI to expand what our marketing team can do at all. You'll surface opportunities we can't currently see and take on work that isn't practical by hand, like analyzing every creative we've run to learn what truly drives performance. Efficiency is the floor; new capability is the ceiling. A core part of this role is finding those frontier use cases, proving which ones hold, and turning them into things the team relies on.




THE SENIOR AI MARKETING ENABLEMENT MANAGER WILL:

 - Own the capability
   
   - Take full ownership of the assets built with our external enablement partner: tools, agents, MCP servers, prompts, evals, and documentation. Make sure they remain reliable, understood, and extensible as the program grows.
   
   - Own the marketing AI roadmap end to end. Prioritize what to build next, decide what to sunset, sequence work against marketing's goals, and set the standards and patterns the team builds against.
   
   - Own and advance the AI maturity model already in motion, moving marketers from first useful wins to regular integration to self-sufficiency, and report progress and impact to marketing leadership.
   
   - Define the measurement framework for the program: workflows transformed, time saved (measured before/after), adoption, maturity progression, and library reuse, and use it to make the case for where to invest next.

 - Build
   
   - Build AI-powered tools, agents, automations, and skills tailored to real marketing workflows, such as campaign planning, audience research, content development, channel execution, reporting, experimentation, and optimization.
   
   - Build and maintain integrations that connect AI to live data, including MCP servers linking ad platforms, analytics, and CRM, so marketers can work against real data in natural language instead of exporting and reconciling by hand.
   
   - Set and enforce quality and reliability practices: evals, regression tests, and human-in-the-loop review so tools can be trusted against real campaigns and real data, and don't silently break when models or platforms change.
   
   - Establish the architecture and conventions for how marketing AI tooling is structured, versioned, documented, and extended, so that future hires and marketers can build on it without you in the loop.

 - Expand what's possible
   
   - Use AI to uncover opportunities the team can't currently see: patterns across campaigns, audiences, creative, channels, and content that would be impractical to surface by hand.
   
   - Take on analysis at a scale humans can't, such as evaluating hundreds of creative variants, ad transcripts, landing pages, or search terms at once to extract what's working and why, then feeding that back into strategy.
   
   - Prototype net-new capabilities, not just faster versions of existing work: test whether they hold, and turn the ones that prove valuable into durable, repeatable tools.
   
   - Act as the marketing organization's point of view on AI: evaluate new models, tools, and approaches as they emerge, and make clear recommendations on what to adopt, what to wait on, and what to ignore.

 - Coach and scale
   
   - Embed with marketers to deeply understand their workflows, goals, deliverables, tools, and pain points, and identify the highest-leverage places AI creates real leverage.
   
   - Coach marketers through a practical adoption journey, from first win to regular use to building their own workflows, adapting your approach to each person's level of AI fluency.
   
   - Recognize patterns across individual use cases and turn one-offs into reusable playbooks, templates, and tools, documented in version control so any marketer can read, run, and extend them.
   
   - Share wins and examples to build momentum, confidence, and excitement around AI-enabled marketing work.
   
   - Lead the expansion of the model beyond Demand Gen into the broader marketing organization, including scoping, sequencing, and stakeholder alignment with marketing leaders in other functions.

 - Operate responsibly
   
   - Partner with Data, Security, and IT as the accountable owner for marketing's AI practices: approved AI providers, sound data handling, appropriate human review, and clear accountability for AI outputs and actions.
   
   - Define and document the governance standards that marketing AI tooling must meet before it runs against real campaigns and real customer data, and keep them current as the capability grows.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU SHOULD HAVE:

 - A track record of building AI-powered tools, agents, automations, custom assistants, or integrations that were adopted and used by others on real workflows.

 - Experience owning a technical capability or program end-to-end, including setting direction, making prioritization trade-offs, and being accountable for outcomes.

 - Deep understanding of how marketing teams work, across demand generation, lifecycle, paid acquisition, SEO/GEO/AEO, content, marketing operations, analytics, or growth, and the ability to quickly identify where AI creates meaningful leverage.

 - Mature judgment about what should and shouldn't be automated, and the confidence to push back.

 - A frontier mindset with the curiosity to spot where AI can do something genuinely new, not just faster, and the drive to prototype it, test it, and prove whether it holds.

 - A quality mindset: experience defining evals, testing outputs, and designing the human-in-the-loop checkpoints that make AI trustworthy in production.

 - Strong coaching and enablement skills, with a history of bringing non-technical people from not using AI to building their own workflows.

 - Strong systems thinking: you turn one-off improvements into scalable, documented patterns, and you design so others can extend your work without you.

 - The ability to influence without authority across functions and seniority levels, including partnering with Data, Security, and IT and presenting to senior leadership.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity in a fast-moving field, and a habit of keeping current as


IT WOULD BE REALLY GREAT IF YOU HAD:

 - Experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Applied AI Lead, or AI Enablement Lead, or in a consulting role where you built AI tooling inside a client's business.

 - Direct experience on a Demand Generation, Growth, Marketing Operations, Lifecycle, or Performance Marketing team.

 - Familiarity with modern marketing and data tooling such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Campaign Manager 360, GA4, Google Tag Manager, AppsFlyer, Firebase, Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Cube.

 - Familiarity with current AI development and automation tooling. The specifics change quickly, but today that includes assistants and models (Claude, ChatGPT), agentic and dev tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, agent SDKs), the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting agents to data and systems, orchestration and automation tools (LangGraph, n8n, Zapier, Make), eval/observability tooling, and version control (GitHub).

 - Familiarity with campaign measurement, funnel analysis, experimentation, attribution, segmentation, or personalization.

 - Experience in change management, enablement, consulting, solutions engineering, or technical program management.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Machine Learning Engineer based in Brazil. Working across the entire machine learning lifecycle, you will assess existing systems, refine established models, and design scalable architectures that deliver measurable business value.   • Assess existing recommendation systems, customer intelligence capabilities, data pipelines, and evaluation methodologies to establish performance baselines and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Ensure technical solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with production engineering best practices.

Our partner is looking for a Director, Customer Success - Public Sector based in the United States. As Director of Customer Success for the Public Sector, you will lead the strategy and team responsible for driving customer adoption, retention, and growth across federal, state, local, and education (SLED) organizations. You will shape the customer success model for a rapidly expanding public sector business, building on strong customer relationships and a high-performing team. Working closely with Sales, Renewals, Channel, Support, and Product, you will ensure a coordinated and consistent customer experience. Your expertise in government procurement, compliance frameworks, and public sector buying cycles will help customers achieve long-term value. You will also champion data-driven and AI-enabled processes to improve operational efficiency and strengthen customer engagement. This is an opportunity to contribute to the security of public institutions while helping scale a strategic business function.

You will lead the Public Sector Customer Success organization, developing its strategy, strengthening customer relationships, and ensuring measurable business outcomes across a diverse portfolio of government and education customers.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers serving federal and SLED customers, building on existing strengths and supporting continued professional growth.

  • Define and execute the Public Sector Customer Success strategy, including customer coverage models, success planning frameworks, and playbooks tailored to government organizations.

  • Own customer adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes, ensuring accurate forecasting that reflects government fiscal years, funding cycles, and contract vehicles.

  • Build and maintain executive relationships with senior government stakeholders, including CISOs, CIOs, program leaders, and procurement decision-makers.

  • Act as a senior escalation point for critical customer issues, ensuring effective resolution and long-term relationship health.

  • Partner with Public Sector Sales leadership to establish clear post-sale responsibilities, communication processes, and a coordinated customer experience.

  • Collaborate with Renewals, Channel teams, and resellers to support compliant and predictable renewals, as well as approved expansion opportunities such as contract true-ups and scope changes.

  • Apply knowledge of FedRAMP, GovRAMP, StateRAMP, and government procurement requirements to customer onboarding, support, and renewal processes.

  • Represent public sector customer needs to Product and Engineering teams, providing prioritized, business-driven feedback to inform product improvements.

  • Promote AI-enabled workflows and data-driven customer health and risk management to increase efficiency and allow CSMs to focus on high-impact activities.

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop Customer Success professionals with the expertise needed to serve federal customers as the business scales.

  • Established relationships across federal, state, local, or education organizations, with the credibility to engage customers and support Sales initiatives.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Trading Desk Platform (C++) based in India. We are seeking an experienced technical leader to take ownership of the core infrastructure powering a newly established proprietary trading desk. In this role, you will design and build a high-performance, low-latency trading platform using modern C++, with a strong focus on system reliability, execution efficiency, and capital protection. You will lead the development of critical components, including the strategy runtime, risk management layer, and order and position management systems. Working closely with senior architecture, quantitative, and data specialists, you will help shape the technical foundations of an ambitious trading operation. The platform will initially integrate with leading cryptocurrency exchanges, with plans to expand into traditional futures and equity markets. This is an opportunity to make significant architectural decisions, drive technical excellence, and have a direct impact on the performance and security of trading operations.
  • Lead the design and development of a robust Strategy SDK with event-driven interfaces for market data, trades, orders, account events, and timers.
  • Build and maintain a high-performance strategy runtime supporting independent execution, monitoring, recovery, and multiple operating modes, including live trading, dry-run, and backtesting.
  • Design and implement comprehensive pre-trade risk controls, including order size limits, price collars, position limits, loss thresholds, and stale-data protection.
  • Develop desk-wide risk monitoring and margin management systems across multiple exchanges to ensure effective oversight of trading exposure.
  • Build reliable order and position management infrastructure, including transaction journaling, crash recovery, exchange reconciliation, and fail-safe mechanisms.
  • Implement kill switches and automated risk controls to safeguard trading capital and prevent unintended trading activity.
  • Develop and maintain exchange connectors, starting with Binance, using a scalable and shared connectivity framework.
  • Ensure consistent and deterministic strategy execution across backtesting, simulation, and live trading environments.
  • Collaborate closely with the HFT Architecture Lead and data engineering team to align platform development with system architecture, exchange connectivity, and backtesting infrastructure.
  • Establish and maintain high standards for system reliability, testing, documentation, maintainability, and developer experience.

    • Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++, particularly C++17 and C++20, with experience developing production-grade software.
  • Extensive experience designing and building high-performance, event-driven systems, ideally in trading or other latency-sensitive environments.
  • Deep understanding of trading system fundamentals, including order lifecycles, position management, profit and loss (PnL), margin requirements, and liquidation mechanisms.
  • Proven experience developing and operating production-grade risk management systems, order management systems, or trading infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with exchange connectivity, including market data feeds and order execution APIs, across cryptocurrency or traditional financial markets.
  • Strong understanding of system correctness, deterministic execution, fault tolerance, crash recovery, and operational resilience.
  • Ability to design clean, scalable APIs and developer-friendly interfaces that support efficient strategy development.
  • Strong technical ownership, problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to work independently within a small, highly experienced engineering team.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively alongside architects, quantitative researchers, and other technical specialists.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience working at a proprietary trading firm, high-frequency trading (HFT) firm, market maker, or financial exchange.
  • Experience developing market-making, arbitrage, or cross-exchange trading systems.
  • Knowledge of cross-venue risk management, collateral optimization, and multi-exchange trading operations.
  • Python programming experience for tooling, automation, and infrastructure development.

  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week.

  • Experienced team: Work alongside senior professionals in trading architecture, quantitative development, and data engineering.
  • Career impact: Contribute directly to building high-performance trading infrastructure with opportunities for future expansion into additional financial markets.

In this role, you will design and build a high-performance, low-latency trading platform using modern C++, with a strong focus on system reliability, execution efficiency, and capital protection. You will lead the development of critical components, including the strategy runtime, risk management layer, and order and position management systems. Working closely with senior architecture, quantitative, and data specialists, you will help shape the technical foundations of an ambitious trading operation. The platform will initially integrate with leading cryptocurrency exchanges, with plans to expand into traditional futures and equity markets. This is an opportunity to make significant architectural decisions, drive technical excellence, and have a direct impact on the performance and security of trading operations.
  • Lead the design and development of a robust Strategy SDK with event-driven interfaces for market data, trades, orders, account events, and timers.
  • Build and maintain a high-performance strategy runtime supporting independent execution, monitoring, recovery, and multiple operating modes, including live trading, dry-run, and backtesting.
  • Design and implement comprehensive pre-trade risk controls, including order size limits, price collars, position limits, loss thresholds, and stale-data protection.
  • Develop desk-wide risk monitoring and margin management systems across multiple exchanges to ensure effective oversight of trading exposure.
  • Build reliable order and position management infrastructure, including transaction journaling, crash recovery, exchange reconciliation, and fail-safe mechanisms.
  • Implement kill switches and automated risk controls to safeguard trading capital and prevent unintended trading activity.
  • Develop and maintain exchange connectors, starting with Binance, using a scalable and shared connectivity framework.
  • Ensure consistent and deterministic strategy execution across backtesting, simulation, and live trading environments.
  • Collaborate closely with the HFT Architecture Lead and data engineering team to align platform development with system architecture, exchange connectivity, and backtesting infrastructure.
  • Establish and maintain high standards for system reliability, testing, documentation, maintainability, and developer experience.

    • Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++, particularly C++17 and C++20, with experience developing production-grade software.
  • Extensive experience designing and building high-performance, event-driven systems, ideally in trading or other latency-sensitive environments.
  • Deep understanding of trading system fundamentals, including order lifecycles, position management, profit and loss (PnL), margin requirements, and liquidation mechanisms.
  • Proven experience developing and operating production-grade risk management systems, order management systems, or trading infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with exchange connectivity, including market data feeds and order execution APIs, across cryptocurrency or traditional financial markets.
  • Strong understanding of system correctness, deterministic execution, fault tolerance, crash recovery, and operational resilience.
  • Ability to design clean, scalable APIs and developer-friendly interfaces that support efficient strategy development.
  • Strong technical ownership, problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to work independently within a small, highly experienced engineering team.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively alongside architects, quantitative researchers, and other technical specialists.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience working at a proprietary trading firm, high-frequency trading (HFT) firm, market maker, or financial exchange.
  • Experience developing market-making, arbitrage, or cross-exchange trading systems.
  • Knowledge of cross-venue risk management, collateral optimization, and multi-exchange trading operations.
  • Python programming experience for tooling, automation, and infrastructure development.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive salary: Annual compensation ranging from $200,000 to $250,000.
  • Fully remote working: Work remotely with flexibility across EST–CET time zones.
  • Flexible location: Ideally based in Cyprus, with openness to candidates across the EST–CET time zones.
  • Permanent employment: Long-term opportunity within an ambitious and technically driven environment.
  • Paid annual leave: 24 days of annual leave.
  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week.
  • Significant technical ownership: Opportunity to shape a proprietary trading platform from the ground up and influence critical architectural and engineering decisions.
  • Experienced team: Work alongside senior professionals in trading architecture, quantitative development, and data engineering.
  • Career impact: Contribute directly to building high-performance trading infrastructure with opportunities for future expansion into additional financial markets.

Working remotely within an international environment, you will collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to strengthen organizational resilience and continuously improve security operations.

As a Lead SOC Analyst, you will drive the effectiveness of security operations by overseeing threat monitoring, coordinating incident response, and continuously improving detection capabilities. You will combine technical investigations with team leadership, compliance ownership, and strategic reporting to ensure security threats are identified and addressed efficiently.

  • SOC Leadership: Define detection and response priorities, act as the senior escalation point for security incidents, and mentor and coach security analysts.

  • Security Monitoring and Alert Triage: Monitor alerts from SIEM, EDR, identity, network, cloud, and SaaS platforms, validating, prioritizing, investigating, and escalating potential threats.

  • Incident Response: Lead security incidents from initial investigation through containment, eradication, and recovery, coordinating stakeholders and providing clear status updates.

  • Digital Forensics and Investigation: Analyze logs, endpoint telemetry, and network traffic to determine incident scope, root causes, and business impact while preserving relevant evidence.

  • Threat Hunting: Proactively identify suspicious activity and previously undetected threats using threat intelligence, attacker techniques, and behavioral indicators.

  • Detection Engineering: Develop, test, and optimize detection rules aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework to improve security coverage and reduce false positives.

Our partner is looking for a License Renewal Engineer Consultant 2 (Electrical) – Nuclear based in the United States. Contribute to the long-term safety, reliability, and continued operation of the US nuclear power fleet by supporting license renewal (LR) and subsequent license renewal (SLR) programs. In this remote, full-time role, you will apply your electrical engineering expertise to nuclear plant aging management reviews, regulatory compliance, and post-approval implementation activities.   • Perform system scoping, screening, and aging management reviews for nuclear power plant systems in support of Subsequent License Renewal applications, following NEI 17-01 and applicable industry best practices.

  • Collaborate with engineering and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) requirements and license extension commitments.

  • Develop and maintain engineering program basis documentation, validate technical data, track engineering changes, and support configuration management.

  • Plan and coordinate required inspections to meet NRC regulations and license renewal commitments.

  • Review inspection work orders to verify that applicable license renewal criteria and aging management requirements are addressed.

  • Support implementation activities following license approval, including procedure updates, preventive maintenance basis and frequency development, and work order preparation and review.

  • Contribute to online and outage work management and scheduling, nuclear program documentation, and closure of NRC commitments.

  • Support NRC inspection readiness and related regulatory activities, including preparation and review of technical documentation.

  • Serve as a technical resource for clients and, when required, interact directly with NRC representatives.

  • Monitor developments in aging management regulations, engineering methods, industry practices, and nuclear plant operating experience.

  • Promote continuous improvement, cross-functional collaboration, and the appropriate use of technology to improve engineering quality and efficiency.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline from an ABET-accredited institution.

  • At least 10 years of experience in engineering, licensing engineering, program engineering, design engineering, power plant inspection, or a related field. Nuclear power or another highly regulated industry is strongly preferred.

  • Experience producing accurate, high-quality technical documentation in a highly regulated environment.

  • Familiarity with engineering documentation systems, nuclear quality assurance and quality control protocols, and configuration management practices.

  • Strong systems-thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to balance technical innovation with regulatory compliance, safety, and traceability.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, regulatory, and client stakeholders and communicate complex technical information clearly.

  • Preferred qualifications and experience include:

  • Background in nuclear power plant operations, engineering, or design.

  • Experience working with NRC, Institute of Nuclear Power Operations (INPO), or Department of Energy (DOE) requirements.

  • Previous involvement in license renewal, subsequent license renewal, or nuclear aging management programs.

  • Experience evaluating electrical components and systems for aging effects, including cable insulation and connections, metal-enclosed bus, fuse holders, and insulators.

  • Familiarity with relevant nuclear industry guidance and standards, including NUREG-1800, NUREG-1801, NEI 95-10, NUREG-2191, NUREG-2192, NUREG-2221, NEI 17-01, and/or NUREG-1555.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Science Lead based in Norway.   • Build performance visibility: Translate measurement findings into accessible dashboards and metrics that support marketing teams and leadership in evaluating performance and making informed decisions.

  • Support team development: Provide informal guidance, analytical feedback, and methodology reviews to colleagues across growth and analytics teams.

  • Deep expertise in experimentation methodology, including experimental design, sample-size calculations, p-values, confidence intervals, and statistical interpretation.

  • Strong understanding of the B2B sales funnel and the complexity of measuring performance across extended buyer journeys.

  • Proven ability to solve complex marketing measurement challenges, develop new analytical methodologies, and demonstrate significant business impact.

  • Experience translating advanced statistical findings into clear recommendations that influence marketing strategy and budget decisions.

  • Familiarity with paid advertising platforms, including Google, Meta, and LinkedIn, and an interest in testing new platform capabilities.

Working closely with Product Management and Sales Enablement, you will translate complex technical capabilities into compelling value propositions for technical practitioners and executive audiences. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Programmer based in United States. We are seeking an experienced Principal Programmer to provide technical and strategic leadership across clinical statistical programming projects. In this role, you will support a diverse portfolio of clinical trials, collaborating with statistical, scientific, and cross-functional teams across multiple therapeutic areas. You will oversee the development, validation, and review of clinical datasets, statistical outputs, and programming specifications. Beyond your technical responsibilities, you will contribute to project delivery, team development, and client relationships. This position offers the opportunity to influence programming standards, drive process improvements, and ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. You will work in a collaborative, quality-focused environment where technical expertise, scientific understanding, and leadership are highly valued.
  • Provide expert programming support across multiple clinical studies, projects, clients, and therapeutic areas.
  • Review clinical trial documentation, including study protocols, Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), Case Report Forms (CRFs), and Clinical Study Reports (CSRs).
  • Author, review, and approve study-specific Tables, Figures, and Listings (TFLs) shells and dataset specifications.
  • Develop, validate, document, and maintain programming code for clinical datasets, statistical outputs, and reusable macros, ensuring compliance with programming best practices.
  • Identify data discrepancies, issues, and outliers, investigating and resolving them or escalating them when necessary.
  • Complete, review, and approve CDISC validation reports while ensuring adherence to applicable data standards.
  • Monitor emerging industry standards and assess their impact on ongoing and future clinical trials.
  • Maintain strong proficiency in R programming and stay informed about relevant technical developments.
  • Ensure study master files and other essential project documentation remain complete, accurate, and audit-ready.
  • Lead internal and client-facing study meetings, project discussions, and cross-functional collaborations.
  • Present project updates, communicate technical findings, and provide clear recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.
  • Share scientific, technical, and practical knowledge across teams, supporting continuous learning and professional development.
  • Develop and deliver internal technical training where appropriate.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives to enhance programming efficiency, quality, and consistency.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with clients and colleagues while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, internal procedures, and quality standards.
  • Depending on business needs, take on supervisory responsibilities, including team management, mentoring, and project leadership.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in a numerical or quantitative discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • At least 8 years of relevant industry experience in clinical statistical programming.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a clinical statistical programming lead role.
  • Strong proficiency in R and practical experience handling, processing, and analyzing clinical trial data.
  • Solid understanding of the clinical drug development process, including therapeutic areas, clinical endpoints, and study designs.
  • Knowledge of clinical programming standards, industry best practices, and relevant ICH guidelines.
  • Experience working with CDISC standards and validating clinical datasets and statistical deliverables.
  • Ability to interpret clinical trial documentation and translate statistical requirements into accurate programming specifications and outputs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical information clearly.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, particularly when working with clients and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including the ability to manage projects, supervise teams, and coordinate multiple deliverables.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and self-management abilities, with a focus on delivering accurate, high-quality work within established deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative team environment.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development, knowledge sharing, and process improvement.

    • Benefits:

  • Professional Development: Opportunities to expand technical expertise and contribute to innovative clinical programming practices.
  • Leadership Opportunities: Scope to lead projects, support team development, and influence technical and operational processes.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside experienced professionals across statistics, programming, clinical research, and other disciplines.
  • Scientific Exposure: Gain experience across diverse clinical trials, therapeutic areas, and drug development projects.
  • Continuous Learning: Opportunities to share knowledge, participate in technical training, and stay up to date with evolving industry standards.
  • Purpose-Driven Culture: Join an organization committed to responsible business practices, social impact, sustainability, and high standards of accountability.
  • Inclusive Workplace: Equal employment opportunities and a working culture built on integrity, honesty, mutual respect, and diversity.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal QA Engineer based in the United States. The Principal QA Engineer will lead the quality engineering practice across a diverse portfolio of software businesses, establishing consistent standards, scalable automation frameworks, and measurable quality processes. This senior, hands-on individual contributor role combines technical leadership with strategic influence, helping engineering teams deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing products. You will define testing strategies, oversee automation architecture, and establish quality gates throughout the software development lifecycle. A key focus will be ensuring that products meet the expectations of regulated customers through robust testing evidence, traceability, and compliance support. You will also help teams modernize legacy systems, strengthen AI testing practices, and improve engineering maturity. Working across multiple technology teams, you will lead through technical expertise, practical standards, and measurable results in a fully remote environment.

As the owner of portfolio-wide quality engineering standards, you will shape how testing is designed, implemented, measured, and continuously improved across multiple businesses. You will remain actively involved in technical delivery while guiding teams through shared practices and frameworks. Your responsibilities will include:

- Quality engineering strategy and standards

  • Define and maintain the portfolio-wide quality engineering strategy, including test policies, risk-based approaches, testing levels, and the appropriate balance of unit, API, integration, UI, and end-to-end testing.

  • Establish testing conventions, definitions of done, defect severity and priority classifications, entry and exit criteria, and release readiness standards.

  • Maintain a version-controlled quality engineering standard, documenting exceptions with clear ownership and expiration dates.

  • Develop a quality engineering maturity model, assess portfolio companies, and establish improvement plans with technology leaders.

    • - Test architecture and automation

  • Design and own the reference test automation architecture across web, API, mobile, desktop, and data layers.

  • Build and maintain reusable automation frameworks, starter kits, and templates that enable teams to adopt consistent testing practices quickly.

  • Define approaches to contract testing, service virtualization, and integration testing for products with complex external dependencies.

  • Establish testing strategies for legacy and mixed-technology environments, including characterization tests that protect existing functionality during modernization.

  • Set standards for data migration and reconciliation testing in modernization and consolidation initiatives.

  • Write and review framework code, assess test implementations across teams, and directly resolve the most complex automation challenges.

    • - Toolchain, CI/CD, and test environments

  • Select and govern the portfolio QA toolchain, including automation frameworks, test management platforms, browser and device infrastructure, accessibility tools, performance testing solutions, and reporting systems.

  • Define reference tools and approved alternatives, identifying opportunities to consolidate licenses and reduce duplicated costs.

  • Establish CI/CD quality gates in collaboration with DevSecOps, including standards for parallel execution, test duration, and flaky test management.

  • Define test environment standards with cloud platform teams, including on-demand and ephemeral environments where available.

    • - Test data management

  • Establish standards for synthetic test data generation, data masking, and data subsetting.

  • Partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure sensitive production information, including health records, personal data, student records, and financial data, is appropriately protected in non-production environments.

    • - Non-functional and specialist testing

  • Define accessibility testing standards aligned with WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508, combining automated, manual, and assistive technology testing.

  • Own the supporting evidence for Accessibility Conformance Reports.

  • Establish performance and load testing strategies, baselines, and regression checks, identifying when dedicated performance engineering expertise is required.

  • Incorporate dynamic security testing and security regression scenarios into test suites in coordination with the security function.

  • Use production incidents, escaped defects, synthetic monitoring, and observability data to prioritize testing investments.

    • - Regulated quality evidence and traceability

  • Establish requirements-to-test traceability standards so each release produces auditable evidence of what was tested, against which requirements, on which build, and with what results.

  • Align testing and release documentation with SOC 2 change management, HIPAA, and government and education customer requirements.

  • Define software validation approaches and evidence packages when required by products or contractual obligations.

  • Support customer audits, procurement questionnaires, and quality reviews with comprehensive testing documentation.

    • - Quality engineering for AI

  • Collaborate with AI teams to define evaluation datasets, acceptance thresholds, and regression testing practices for AI-powered features.

  • Establish testing approaches for model and prompt changes, non-deterministic outputs, and human review in high-consequence workflows.

  • Evaluate AI-assisted test generation, automated maintenance, and agent-driven exploratory testing, adopting tools where they demonstrably improve coverage or efficiency.

  • Define testing and acceptance requirements for code produced by AI coding agents.

    • - Quality metrics and release readiness

  • Define and monitor portfolio-wide quality metrics, including escaped defects by severity, automated regression coverage, regression cycle time, flaky test rates, change failure rates, and defect detection time.

  • Maintain a portfolio quality dashboard and deliver quarterly reports that provide actionable insights for technical and non-technical leadership.

  • Establish release readiness criteria, define the evidence required for approval, and advise company leadership on release risks.

    • - Practice leadership and capability development

  • Lead the portfolio QA community of practice through standards reviews, technical sessions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

  • Establish hiring standards for QA roles, including role profiles, career levels, interview processes, and technical assessments.

  • Develop onboarding programs, skills matrices, and career progression paths from manual testing to automation and SDET roles.

  • Provide performance feedback and development recommendations for QA engineers working in a dotted-line structure, in collaboration with their direct managers.

    • - Acquisitions and delivery engagements

  • Assess the quality engineering maturity of newly acquired businesses and define quality-related workstreams within integration plans.

  • Establish quality practices for embedded delivery engagements and incorporate reusable testing assets and lessons learned into the shared automation framework.

In this strategic leadership role, you will oversee revenue processes across direct sales, channel partnerships, alliances, and online commercial activities. You will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to improve sales effectiveness, maximize customer retention, and drive sustainable revenue growth. You will lead a team of revenue operations specialists while developing scalable systems, processes, and performance frameworks. Through advanced analytics, automation, and data-driven decision-making, you will identify opportunities to improve productivity and commercial performance. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded leader who thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment and enjoys building high-performing teams and scalable operational structures.
  • Lead and optimize global revenue operations across direct sales, indirect channels, strategic alliances, partnerships, and online sales activities.
  • Build, develop, and manage a high-performing team of Revenue Operations Analysts, ensuring effective operational support, process execution, and sales enablement.
  • Oversee key revenue operations functions, including sales engagement, training and enablement, data enrichment, customer relationship management (CRM), configure-price-quote (CPQ) processes, analytics, and commission management.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve scalable processes across the entire revenue operations lifecycle to enhance efficiency, consistency, and commercial performance.
  • Establish performance metrics and reporting frameworks to monitor lead generation, pipeline development, sales velocity, productivity, customer renewals, and overall revenue effectiveness.
  • Translate business intelligence and performance data into actionable insights, supporting territory and channel management, resource allocation, and strategic decision-making.
  • Partner with executive leadership through regular sales and business reviews, identifying performance gaps and implementing initiatives to improve revenue outcomes.
  • Oversee sales technology platforms and commercial processes, collaborating with systems engineering teams to improve automation, integrations, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead the implementation of new products, pricing structures, packaging, and bundled offerings, ensuring that commercial systems are intuitive and effective for sales teams and partners.
  • Maintain high standards of data accuracy and integrity through order processing, data cleansing, process documentation, reporting, and employee onboarding and training.
  • Lead and enhance commercial review processes for assessing, prioritizing, and managing sales and strategic alliance opportunities.
  • Take ownership of sales compensation and commission plans, including target setting, performance evaluation, and commission payment processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement across revenue operations while ensuring that processes remain scalable and aligned with the organization's global growth objectives.

    • Requirements:

  • Exceptional academic track record, demonstrating strong performance throughout high school and university education.
  • Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline, or an alternative professional background supported by a compelling track record of achievement.
  • Extensive experience in a senior revenue operations leadership position, ideally within a technology-driven, subscription-based business.
  • Proven experience managing and optimizing direct sales operations, channel partnerships, and strategic alliances within an international commercial environment.
  • Strong track record of leveraging technology platforms, business intelligence, analytics, compensation systems, and operational processes to deliver measurable improvements in revenue performance.
  • Deep understanding of revenue operations frameworks, sales processes, CRM systems, pipeline management, customer retention, and commercial performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, developing, and motivating remote teams across multiple geographical regions and time zones.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a systematic approach to identifying inefficiencies and implementing repeatable, scalable solutions.
  • Ability to operate effectively under commercial pressure, establish clear performance expectations, and drive accountability across revenue teams.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate stakeholders at all organizational levels.
  • Outstanding communication, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the ability to secure stakeholder alignment and drive adoption of new processes and systems.
  • Fluent business English, both written and spoken.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to four times per year for company meetings and team events.
  • A proactive, results-oriented mindset, combined with strong leadership capabilities, attention to detail, and a commitment to operational excellence.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive global compensation: Salary packages tailored to geographical location, professional experience, and individual performance.
  • Performance-based rewards: Annual bonus or commission opportunities in addition to base compensation.
  • Regular compensation reviews: Formal compensation assessments twice a year to recognize performance and professional contributions.
  • Fully distributed working environment: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with flexibility across different time zones.
  • International team gatherings: Twice-yearly in-person team sprints, providing opportunities for collaboration and relationship-building.
  • Annual learning and development budget: USD 2,000 per year to support professional growth, training, and skill development.
  • Generous annual leave: 40 days of annual leave per year, including public holidays and designated company-wide holiday periods.
  • Family support: Maternity and paternity leave provisions.
  • Health and wellbeing: Access to a Team Member Assistance Program and dedicated wellness platform.
  • Recognition programs: Company rewards and recognition initiatives celebrating outstanding contributions.
  • International travel opportunities: Opportunities to visit new destinations and meet colleagues, with Priority Pass airport lounge access.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP Concur Specialist based in Switzerland. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Clinical-Coder Quality Assurance Analyst based in United States. The Senior Clinical-Coder Quality Assurance Analyst plays a vital role in maintaining the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of healthcare payment integrity investigations. This professional serves as a final quality checkpoint, reviewing clinical analysts' work to ensure findings are complete, clinically supported, and aligned with applicable coding standards and reimbursement policies. The role combines advanced medical coding expertise, clinical knowledge, and analytical capabilities to identify potential improper payments and validate financial findings. Working with multidisciplinary clinical and operational teams, the successful candidate will strengthen quality assurance practices, improve documentation standards, and support defensible client deliverables. This is an opportunity to contribute to greater transparency and accuracy in healthcare reimbursement within a collaborative, data-driven, and fully remote environment.

The Senior Clinical-Coder Quality Assurance Analyst will oversee quality reviews of clinical investigations and payment integrity findings, ensuring that all analyses meet established standards and are supported by accurate documentation and sound clinical reasoning.

  • Quality Assurance and Review: Conduct detailed quality reviews of Clinical Analysts' work, including claims data, referral case presentations, supporting logic, proposed corrective actions, and identified savings.

  • Perform clinical reviews of referrals and findings to verify that coding, diagnoses, procedures, medical necessity, and appropriateness of care are adequately supported.

  • Ensure that clinical rationales are accurate, defensible, clearly documented, and suitable for presentation to clients and insurance carriers.

  • Coding and Regulatory Compliance: Compare findings against client Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), carrier medical and reimbursement policies, CMS/NCCI guidelines, and relevant industry best practices.

  • Validate findings using reliable resources, including state licensing boards, professional licensing databases, Secretary of State records, EncoderPro, and other relevant platforms.

  • Ensure that all documentation is complete, accurate, and consistent with internal procedures and quality standards.

  • Claims Investigation and Data Analysis: Independently review claims data, claims histories, medical reviews, and provider files to identify potential fraud, waste, abuse (FWA), and other improper payments.

  • Analyze large datasets to detect irregularities, billing patterns, financial relationships, and other indicators requiring further investigation.

  • Quality Standards and Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and maintenance of quality assurance guidelines and documentation.

  • Serve as a subject matter resource for Quality and Clinical Analysts, providing guidance on interpreting and applying quality standards.

  • Analyze recurring quality issues, conduct root cause assessments, and recommend or implement corrective actions.

  • Promote a strong culture of quality, accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement across clinical operations.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines substantial healthcare reimbursement or payment integrity experience with recognized medical coding credentials, strong clinical knowledge, and exceptional analytical and communication skills. They should be comfortable reviewing complex medical claims, investigating potential improper payments, and producing clear, evidence-based conclusions independently.

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in healthcare billing, claims adjudication, fraud investigation, payment integrity operations, and/or healthcare reimbursement.

  • Professional certification in at least one of the following areas: laboratory, radiology, behavioral health, RN, or LPN.

  • Certified Coding Specialist credential through AAPC or AHIMA.

  • Strong understanding of identifying and investigating billing practices and activities that may result in improper payments, including the review of professional, facility, and insured member medical claims.

  • Strong knowledge of clinical terminology, medical procedures, healthcare workflows, and medical coding practices.

  • Demonstrated experience manipulating, analyzing, and interpreting large datasets.

  • Excellent critical-thinking, problem-solving, and written communication skills, with the ability to develop concise, independent, and defensible conclusions.

  • Proven ability to accurately document findings and communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and interpersonal abilities.

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and general computer systems.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams while managing responsibilities independently.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certification as an Accredited Healthcare Fraud Investigator (AHFI), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), or an equivalent credential.

  • At least 5 years of experience working in the billing department of a healthcare provider or medical practice.

  • Previous experience with claims adjudication and healthcare payment processes.

  • Intermediate knowledge of local, state, and federal laws and regulations governing health insurance, including commercial health, pharmacy, and/or dental plans.

  • Experience identifying quality issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing process improvements.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote work opportunity within the United States.

  • Opportunity to contribute to healthcare payment integrity and improve the accuracy of medical claims investigations.

  • Collaborative working environment alongside experienced clinical, quality assurance, and healthcare analytics professionals.

  • Opportunities to apply and further develop expertise in medical coding, clinical review, fraud investigation, and healthcare reimbursement.

  • Opportunity to contribute to the development of quality standards and continuous improvement initiatives.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Digital Asset Executive based in India. We are seeking an experienced Digital Asset Management (DAM) professional to lead the implementation, organization, and ongoing optimization of a digital asset platform. In this role, you will oversee asset workflows, metadata standards, taxonomy, permissions, and archiving to ensure content remains accurate, accessible, and properly managed. Acting as the key liaison between the client and creative studios, you will coordinate asset requirements, campaign storage, photography, and retrieval processes. You will collaborate with enterprise stakeholders to establish consistent data practices and protect usage rights across digital content. This is a remote, three-month assignment suited to someone with strong digital asset expertise, a practical understanding of DAM systems, and a proactive approach to improving operational efficiency.

  • Lead the deployment strategy, implementation, and ongoing workflow management of the Digital Asset Management (DAM) system.

  • Act as the primary point of contact between the client and creative studios regarding naming conventions, campaign storage, digital assets, new photography, and archiving requirements.

  • Develop and maintain metadata entry protocols and collaborate with enterprise stakeholders to define metadata standards and taxonomy guidelines.

  • Promote data consistency and common standards to improve asset organization, searchability, reporting, and analytics.

  • Assign and maintain appropriate metadata for digital assets, ensuring accurate usage rights and supporting compliant asset utilization.

  • Administer the DAM platform, facilitate asset uploads, and coordinate system maintenance, updates, and improvements.

  • Register internal and external users and manage access permissions according to their roles and requirements.

  • Facilitate the retrieval of previously catalogued images, photography, and other digital assets.

  • Process raw images using appropriate software and ensure assets are prepared for effective use and storage.
