You will take ownership of complex technical deliverables, from initial design development through construction documentation and coordination. Working within an international, multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will collaborate with electrical, mechanical, and BIM specialists to develop integrated, high-quality solutions. Your expertise will contribute to the design of hyperscale and AI data centers for major global technology organizations. Combining technical independence with strong coordination skills, you will ensure that designs meet project specifications, industry standards, and delivery requirements. This is an opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to high-profile infrastructure projects, and develop your expertise in a rapidly expanding industry through a long-term remote contractual engagement.
  • Independently develop and coordinate complex ICT and low-voltage system designs, including structured cabling, telecommunications infrastructure, access control, CCTV, video surveillance, and security systems.
  • Create, develop, and coordinate detailed ICT BIM models using Autodesk Revit, ensuring compatibility with other engineering disciplines.
  • Take ownership of assigned design deliverables, ensuring compliance with project scope, technical requirements, budgets, and schedules.
  • Prepare, review, and update ICT drawings, layouts, technical documentation, and design packages in collaboration with project engineers.
  • Develop detailed equipment layouts, cable pathways, telecommunications infrastructure plans, and technical drawings.
  • Support engineering calculations and contribute to the preparation of technical specifications, design criteria, and equipment datasheets.
  • Maintain design scope documentation, identify potential technical risks, and incorporate design revisions throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Review shop drawings and contractor submittals to verify their consistency with the original design intent and project requirements.
  • Produce and review coordinated BIM models and CAD drawings, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable project standards.
  • Identify and resolve technical and multidisciplinary coordination issues, working closely with electrical, mechanical, and BIM teams.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to less experienced designers, sharing knowledge and contributing to overall design quality.
  • Manage multiple design priorities independently while maintaining high technical standards and meeting project deadlines.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in ICT design, telecommunications, or low-voltage systems engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently develop and deliver complex ICT design packages.
  • Strong practical knowledge of structured cabling, telecommunications infrastructure, access control, CCTV, and security systems.
  • Previous experience designing low-voltage systems for industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities; data center experience is strongly preferred.
  • Advanced hands-on proficiency in Autodesk Revit is mandatory, including BIM modelling and multidisciplinary design coordination.
  • Experience with ICT design software, BIM modelling tools, and CAD drawing production.
  • Good understanding of applicable telecommunications standards, low-voltage regulations, and industry codes.
  • Familiarity with TIA and BICSI standards and guidelines is considered an advantage.
  • Ability to develop technical specifications, equipment datasheets, design documentation, and coordinated engineering drawings.
  • Experience reviewing technical deliverables, contractor submissions, and shop drawings.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to resolve technical challenges independently.
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage several assignments simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail, technical judgment, and commitment to quality.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions and collaborate effectively with international, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Written and spoken English proficiency at B1 level or above is preferred. Candidates with strong technical expertise but a lower English level are also encouraged to apply, as alternative opportunities with different language requirements may be available.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer 1 - Nuclear based in the United States. The Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer will contribute to major nuclear power engineering projects, supporting both the modernization of existing facilities and the development of next-generation nuclear technologies. This role focuses on designing, evaluating, and implementing advanced instrumentation and control systems that improve plant performance, reliability, and safety. You will work across digital control platforms, process instrumentation, electrical systems, and equipment automation for nuclear power applications. Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams and clients, you will help deliver technical solutions from initial design through implementation. The position also involves reviewing engineering deliverables, participating in site assessments, and mentoring less experienced engineers. This is an opportunity to support the evolution of carbon-free energy while contributing to complex, technically challenging projects.

The Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer will lead and contribute to instrumentation and control system design activities across nuclear power projects. The role combines technical engineering, client collaboration, design verification, and team development to deliver reliable solutions that meet project requirements and industry standards.

  • Design digital control systems: Develop and support instrumentation and control solutions involving programmable logic controllers (PLCs), distributed control systems (DCS), touchscreen displays, network switches, and other digital control technologies.

  • Prepare technical specifications: Develop functional requirements, procurement specifications, and technical documentation for instrumentation and control components and systems.

  • Evaluate process instrumentation: Prepare instrumentation replacement evaluation reports and support the development of nuclear plant modification packages.

  • Develop control system solutions: Design mechatronic and process control systems for equipment such as pumps, valves, heat exchangers, steam turbines, and nuclear reactors.

  • Produce engineering documentation: Develop and review piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), system design descriptions, and other engineering deliverables.

  • Support project execution and client engagement: Participate in client meetings, conduct site walkdowns, and ensure engineering deliverables meet project expectations and technical requirements.

  • Review engineering designs: Evaluate drawings and technical documentation prepared by other engineers to verify accuracy, quality, and compliance with project specifications.

  • Mentor engineering colleagues: Provide technical guidance and support the professional development of less experienced nuclear instrumentation and controls engineers.

  • Assist with plant outage activities: Provide engineering support during scheduled nuclear power station outages as required.

Senior Payment Integrity Analyst – Inpatient Claims Review

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. This role offers an opportunity to strengthen healthcare payment accuracy by identifying billing errors, improper payments, and potential overpayments in complex inpatient claims. You will focus on high-cost hospital claims, validating coding, billing practices, and Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) assignments. Using advanced analytics, AI-powered tools, and detailed medical documentation, you will uncover irregularities and develop evidence-based findings that support better reimbursement decisions. Working alongside data science and payment integrity specialists, you will help refine analytical methods and improve claim review processes. Your expertise will directly contribute to reducing unnecessary healthcare spending while supporting fair, accurate, and compliant payments.

You will investigate complex inpatient and hospital claims, combining clinical documentation, billing data, coding expertise, and analytical techniques to identify improper payments and deliver actionable findings.

  • Identify and investigate healthcare billing activities that may lead to inaccurate or improper payments, coordinating with insurance carriers, third-party administrators, and other relevant stakeholders.

  • Analyze claims data to detect unusual patterns, billing irregularities, and potential overpayments.

  • Audit hospital and facility claims, including itemized bills, UB-04 claim forms, medical records, and remittance advices, to validate billing and reimbursement accuracy.

  • Review MS-DRG and APR-DRG assignments and inpatient coding to identify upcoding, unbundling, duplicate billing, and other reimbursement irregularities.

  • Evaluate high-cost hospital claims, often exceeding $100,000, against plan documents, provider contracts, reference-based pricing methodologies, and applicable CMS guidelines.

  • Conduct confidential claims investigations using claims data, member information, provider records, medical reviews, and other relevant sources.

  • Document defensible findings and report suspected billing issues and potential overpayments through established channels.

  • Analyze claims and case histories to identify irregularities, billing trends, and potentially relevant financial relationships, using sources such as licensing databases, state boards, and Secretary of State records.

  • Identify and resolve missing data, inconsistencies, and discrepancies in clinical and claims datasets.

  • Maintain accurate claim tracking logs and collaborate with Data Science teams to improve claim-flagging logic and analytical processes.

  • Cross-train in provider referrals and other claims review activities to support flexible coverage across the team.

  • Strong working knowledge of UB-04 billing, CPT/HCPCS coding, and hospital chargemaster structures.

  • Solid understanding of clinical terminology, medical procedures, healthcare workflows, and hospital reimbursement practices.

  • Ability to compare medical records with claims data to identify billing discrepancies and potential savings.

  • Experience reviewing claims documentation and developing accurate, evidence-based conclusions.

You will define architectural standards, guide technology decisions, and ensure that multiple engineering teams can build and deliver seamlessly within a shared ecosystem. Combining strategic leadership with hands-on engineering, you will design distributed systems, oversee integrations, and drive the evolution of complex Java and Kafka-based platforms. You will work closely with client executives, technical leaders, engineering teams, and external partners to align architectural decisions with business objectives. Beyond defining the technical direction, you will actively contribute to implementation, solve complex production challenges, and mentor senior engineers. This is an opportunity to influence critical technology decisions, shape long-term platform strategy, and deliver scalable, resilient solutions in an international, multi-vendor environment.
  • Define and own the target architecture and long-term technical roadmap, ensuring alignment between existing systems, business objectives, and future platform requirements.
  • Establish and maintain architectural standards covering service boundaries, data ownership, event contracts, third-party integrations, and system interoperability.
  • Document architectural decisions through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), diagrams, and technical documentation, ensuring transparency and consistency across engineering teams.
  • Evaluate architectural options based on delivery timelines, operational costs, scalability, performance, and production risks, presenting clear recommendations to clients and stakeholders.
  • Act as the senior technical point of contact for client leadership, business stakeholders, external vendors, and internal program and account management teams.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business implications, enabling informed decision-making at both technical and executive levels.
  • Lead by example through hands-on engineering, developing reference implementations, proof of concepts, and foundational services that establish technical best practices.
  • Participate directly in resolving critical production incidents, supporting engineering teams through troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and remediation.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, establish engineering standards, and ensure consistent implementation across multiple development teams.
  • Mentor engineering managers, team leads, and senior developers, strengthening technical leadership and architectural capabilities across the organization.
  • Support project discovery and estimation activities by assessing technical requirements, dependencies, implementation complexity, and potential delivery risks.
  • Define and oversee non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, security, data consistency, scalability, and infrastructure costs.
  • Establish measurable performance and reliability targets, including peak-load requirements and recovery objectives, and ensure that systems consistently meet them.
  • Drive the continuous evolution of live production platforms, prioritizing technical debt and planning migrations without disrupting business operations.
  • Evaluate and select technologies, frameworks, and infrastructure components based on their long-term value, operational complexity, and maintainability.
  • Ensure that security and compliance requirements are embedded into architectural decisions, including authentication, authorization, data protection, and auditability.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 10 years of professional software engineering experience, including several years in a Software Architect, Principal Engineer, or Technical Lead position.
  • Proven experience designing and leading complex systems operating under significant production traffic, with demonstrable examples of successful architecture decisions and implementations.
  • Deep, up-to-date expertise in Java and Spring Boot, with the ability to review code, guide implementation, and contribute directly to production development.
  • Strong practical experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures, particularly Apache Kafka.
  • Solid understanding of Kafka-based messaging, event schema evolution, data consistency, idempotency, and high-volume message processing.
  • Experience with Kafka Streams and Avro with Schema Registry is highly valued.
  • Strong data modelling capabilities across relational and NoSQL databases, particularly PostgreSQL and Cassandra.
  • Experience with additional data technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, and Redis is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and hexagonal architecture.
  • Experience designing and operating cloud-native applications and distributed infrastructure using Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Cloud, AWS, and on-premise infrastructure environments.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitLab CI.
  • Understanding of observability practices and tools, including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Strong knowledge of application security, authentication and authorization mechanisms, data protection, audit trails, and compliance requirements.
  • Proven ability to lead engineers and influence technical decisions across teams without direct managerial authority.
  • Experience conducting architecture reviews, defining engineering standards, mentoring senior developers, and coordinating multiple teams.
  • Strong client-facing experience, including the ability to communicate and defend technical recommendations with senior stakeholders and executives.
  • Business-oriented mindset, with the ability to assess the financial and operational implications of architectural decisions.
  • Excellent written communication skills, particularly in producing clear technical documentation, architecture proposals, and ADRs.
  • Professional-level English proficiency, with the ability to communicate confidently in international client-facing environments.

    • Additional experience that would be highly valued:

  • Experience with high-traffic consumer platforms and real-time transaction processing.
  • Background in regulated industries, where compliance requirements, audits, and regulatory stakeholders influence architectural decisions.
  • Experience modernizing live production platforms without downtime, including cloud or data center migrations, database transitions, and large-scale event contract changes.
  • Strong practical expertise in Domain-Driven Design and hexagonal architecture.
  • Production experience with Cassandra and Kafka Streams at significant scale.
  • Experience working in multi-vendor environments where several external engineering teams contribute to a shared platform.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools and the ability to assess their practical benefits and limitations.
  • TOGAF certification or relevant cloud architecture certifications.
  • Previous experience in consulting or technology services organizations, particularly in senior client-facing technical leadership roles.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Asset Management Analyst based in Canada. As a Software Asset Management Analyst, you will help ensure that a large and complex IT environment remains compliant, cost-effective, and aligned with software licensing agreements. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Product Analyst – Trust & Safety based in India.   • Investigate emerging abuse patterns and security incidents through detailed analyses, translating findings into actionable product requirements.

  • Conduct competitive and market research on how comparable platforms identify, prevent, and enforce against abuse, informing product strategy and feature development.

  • Monitor core performance indicators, including reporting accuracy and timeliness, proactive abuse detection, detection signal effectiveness, weekly review-queue coverage, and the time required to turn new abuse patterns into measurable controls.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SVP, FP&A based in Austin. The SVP, FP&A will serve as a strategic financial partner to the CFO and Executive Leadership Team, shaping the organization's financial direction and supporting sustainable growth. This senior leadership role oversees financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and performance analytics. By translating loan-level, operational, and financial data into actionable insights, you will influence key decisions across lending, pricing, credit, servicing, funding, staffing, and investment. You will also build and develop a scalable FP&A function, strengthening financial visibility and accountability across the business. Working closely with executive and operational leaders, you will drive profitability, operational efficiency, and informed decision-making in a growing financial services environment.

As a key member of the finance leadership team, you will lead strategic planning and financial performance management while building the systems, processes, and team needed to support the organization's continued development. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Advise the CFO, CEO, and Executive Leadership Team through financial analysis, business cases, scenario modeling, and recommendations on growth, pricing, credit, staffing, technology, capital, and expenses.

  • Lead the annual strategic planning process and maintain a three- to five-year financial plan, translating business priorities into measurable financial targets.

  • Oversee annual budgeting and develop a driver-based rolling forecast covering originations, revenue, loan profitability, servicing economics, funding costs, expenses, headcount, and cash flow.

  • Establish planning assumptions, responsibilities, and timelines across departments, while analyzing forecast variances and recommending corrective actions.

  • Develop financial models to evaluate profitability and contribution margins by loan, product, channel, branch, and portfolio.

  • Analyze origination volume, pull-through rates, pricing, production costs, sales compensation, staffing, and market expansion to distinguish profitable growth from volume growth.

  • Evaluate portfolio and servicing performance, including delinquencies, losses, recoveries, and servicing costs, incorporating expected credit outcomes into financial forecasts.

  • Model funding capacity, warehouse costs, interest-rate scenarios, liquidity, and capital requirements in partnership with the CFO and Capital Markets.

  • Drive cost management and operating efficiency through productivity, staffing, cost allocation, and operating leverage analyses.

  • Prepare ROI assessments for major investments and technology initiatives, and monitor the impact of efficiency programs.

  • Establish a comprehensive KPI framework connecting operational indicators with financial outcomes.

  • Deliver executive dashboards and management reporting packages, leading monthly performance reviews and supporting corrective action planning.

  • Improve financial planning, reporting, and data systems in collaboration with IT, Accounting, and Operations, strengthening data quality, consistency, and accessibility.

  • Automate recurring reports and forecasts while implementing appropriate controls over financial and operational data.

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing FP&A team through recruitment, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.

  • Partner with Originations, Servicing, Capital Markets, Accounting, HR, and IT to strengthen financial accountability and business performance.

  • Work with HR to align incentive compensation structures with production, quality, and profitability objectives.

  • MBA, CPA, or CFA designation preferred.

  • At least 12 years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or financial services, including leadership of an FP&A function and a high-performing team.

  • Serve as the primary escalation and resolution point for complex new construction and multifamily transactions, working across teams to address underwriting and operational challenges.

  • Conduct early deal reviews and structuring consultations with Sales to assess complex or borderline transactions, establish executable loan structures, and reduce downstream credit exceptions.

  • Oversee pipeline progression, improve workflow efficiency, and manage production strategies for alternative lending products, including multifamily and other specialized transaction types.

  • Perform and oversee detailed multifamily cash flow analysis, evaluating income, expenses, and stabilization assumptions to ensure transactions are structured appropriately.

  • Monitor construction projects from origination through final draw, verifying that required milestones are achieved and identifying schedule, budget, or performance risks early.

  • Coordinate with borrowers, Sales, and Servicing partners to address project delays and mitigate potential losses.

  • Partner with Capital Markets on loan sales and due diligence requests, ensuring construction loan files are complete, properly documented, and aligned with investor and secondary-market expectations.

  • Work with Operations and Technology teams to identify automation gaps and implement system improvements that support more efficient cross-functional workflows.

  • Contribute to construction credit policy development and collaborate with Credit Risk teams on policy implementation and updates.

  • Align credit guidelines and standard operating procedures, establish feedback loops to resolve operational inconsistencies, and enforce documentation requirements before files enter credit review.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of jurisdiction-specific legal requirements for new construction and applicable insurance standards, including builder's risk coverage.

  • Ensure credit policies and loan documentation reflect relevant legal and insurance requirements across all markets served.

  • Lead, coach, and mentor a team of Construction Underwriters through regular feedback, performance evaluations, professional development, and effective workload management.

  • Foster an open, collaborative, and communicative team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements:

    You are an experienced underwriting or construction lending professional with strong analytical capabilities, a thorough understanding of real estate finance, and the leadership skills to manage complex transactions and specialized teams. You can navigate regulatory and operational requirements, make sound decisions under pressure, and translate business needs into practical process and technology improvements.

  • At least 7 years of experience in underwriting, construction lending, real estate finance, or a closely related field.

  • At least 1 year of people management experience, including the ability to coach, develop, and evaluate team members.

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative business or finance discipline, such as Finance, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, or Business Analytics.

  • Demonstrated experience using quantitative analysis to support business decisions.

  • Solid understanding of secondary-market dynamics, including construction loan sales and the due diligence standards applied by institutional investors.

  • Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific legal requirements governing new construction projects.

  • Working knowledge of insurance requirements for new construction, including builder's risk coverage.

  • Proven ability to monitor construction projects from origination through draw requests and ensure compliance with project milestones.

  • Strong multifamily property cash flow analysis skills, including the ability to assess income, expenses, and stabilization assumptions.

  • Strong knowledge of property valuation methods and appraisal types, with the ability to guide valuation processes and explain methodologies to Underwriting, Sales, Risk, and external partners.

  • Ability to quickly master the tools and systems used by construction underwriting teams.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude or Copilot, supported by an automation-first mindset.

  • Strong independent troubleshooting skills and the ability to translate operational requirements into technical solutions.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple functions.

  • Preferred experience with Tableau, JIRA, Trust Point, and Appraisal Works.

  • Salesforce experience is preferred.

  • Commitment to following security policies and data-handling procedures, completing mandatory security awareness training, and promptly reporting suspected security incidents or suspicious activity.

    • Benefits:

  • Annual base salary ranging from $101,600 to $152,400 USD, depending on experience, skills, location, internal equity, and business needs.

  • Annual bonus of 25%, paid quarterly.

  • Company equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans.

  • Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Dependent Care FSA options.

  • 401(k) retirement savings plan.

  • Commuter benefits.

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance.

  • 10 observed holidays and a paid time off (PTO) plan.

  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave.

  • Continuing education reimbursement.

  • Remote working opportunity.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UX/UI Designer (B2B Travel App) based in Netherlands. As a UX/UI Designer, you will shape the user experience of a B2B travel platform designed for professionals managing complex travel arrangements across maritime, aviation, and energy industries. You will focus on creating intuitive, efficient, and user-centered booking experiences that simplify demanding workflows for travel coordinators. Working closely with Product Owners, engineers, and the Art Director, you will transform user needs into practical, streamlined product solutions. You will take ownership of the entire design process, from understanding user challenges and mapping workflows to prototyping, testing, and implementation. Using AI-powered design tools, you will rapidly develop interactive prototypes and explore multiple design directions. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a product used daily by international enterprise clients while helping shape the future of AI-assisted product design.
  • Understand users' needs, objectives, and daily challenges by working closely with travel coordinators and Product Owners before starting each design initiative.
  • Translate business and user problems into intuitive end-to-end user journeys, simplifying complex booking, administration, and back-office workflows.
  • Design efficient interfaces that minimize unnecessary clicks, keystrokes, scrolling, and decision-making while improving overall usability.
  • Create comprehensive user flows covering all possible scenarios, including empty states, error messages, exceptions, and process failures.
  • Develop interactive prototypes using AI-powered design tools such as Claude Design, Figma Make, or equivalent platforms, delivering multiple design alternatives quickly and clearly explaining their respective trade-offs.
  • Conduct usability testing with real users, gather feedback, evaluate design effectiveness, and refine or reconsider solutions based on findings.
  • Work within the existing design system, leveraging established components and introducing new ones only when necessary.
  • Collaborate continuously with engineers throughout the prototyping and development stages, identifying technical constraints early and ensuring design feasibility.
  • Review implemented solutions, communicate design decisions and rationale, and refine interface details to ensure high-quality product releases.
  • Enhance the overall user experience through clean, precise, and uncluttered interfaces, incorporating micro-animations and transitions where they add value.
  • Contribute to improving the team's design practices, particularly the integration of AI-powered tools into product design and prototyping workflows.
  • Take ownership of UX quality within a designated product area and help establish consistent design and prototyping standards across the team.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of professional experience designing B2B or SaaS products that have been successfully launched and used by real customers.
  • Experience working across at least five product design projects, demonstrating the ability to manage different user needs and product challenges.
  • A strong portfolio featuring links to live products you have designed, including at least one complex, data-heavy interface such as an admin panel, back-office platform, or enterprise management tool.
  • Ability to demonstrate complete user journeys, design reasoning, edge-case considerations, and final interface solutions through your portfolio.
  • Strong user-centered design skills, with the ability to connect design decisions to user objectives, pain points, and measurable improvements.
  • Practical experience conducting usability tests with your own prototypes and using user feedback to improve, change, or abandon initial design directions.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-powered design and prototyping tools such as Claude Design, Figma Make, or similar solutions as part of your regular workflow.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated designs, refine their output, and ensure the resulting interfaces meet usability and quality standards.
  • Strong understanding of design systems, reusable components, and the ability to determine when existing components should be reused or new ones introduced.
  • Experience designing complex interfaces with significant amounts of information, multiple states, and sophisticated user workflows.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, engineers, and design leadership.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain design decisions and discuss alternative solutions.
  • Good spoken and written English proficiency (minimum B2 level), with the ability to collaborate daily with colleagues from more than 30 countries.
  • Skills in micro-animations or illustration are considered an additional advantage.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: Monthly gross compensation ranging from €4,500 to €6,000, depending on experience and profile.
  • Remote flexibility: Fully remote working arrangement, allowing you to work from anywhere in Europe, subject to eligibility requirements.
  • International environment: Collaborate with a diverse, multicultural team representing more than 30 nationalities.
  • Creative ownership: Take responsibility for UX quality within your product area and directly influence how users interact with the platform.
  • Modern design environment: Work with established design systems and explore innovative AI-powered design and prototyping tools.
  • Professional development: Strengthen your expertise in product design, usability testing, and AI-assisted design methodologies.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with experienced professionals across Product, Engineering, and Design.
  • Flexible contractor arrangement: Full-time engagement under a contractor agreement, with further details about the package provided during the recruitment process.

The Vice President, Global GTM Sales Operations will lead the operational strategy and execution behind a global go-to-market organization, ensuring that commercial priorities translate into measurable business results. Reporting to the SVP of GTM Operations, this executive will oversee teams supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Partners, and SDRs. They will drive rigorous planning, improve forecasting accuracy, strengthen deal execution, and establish consistent operating rhythms across functions and regions. The role combines executive-level strategic partnership with hands-on operational leadership, using data, technology, and AI-enabled workflows to improve productivity and decision-making. As a builder of high-performing teams, the successful candidate will develop operational leaders who proactively challenge assumptions, deliver actionable insights, and drive accountability.

The Vice President will own the operating framework for global go-to-market execution, leading a team of operations directors and ensuring that planning, forecasting, talent management, and cross-functional processes support sustainable growth.

  • Lead Operations Directors across Global Sales, Customer Experience, Partners, SDRs, and Marketing, establishing clear objectives, KPIs, and accountability standards.

  • Build and optimize a balanced onshore and nearshore operating model, incorporating AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual effort in forecasting, reporting, data management, and operational inspection.

  • Own the annual and quarterly GTM planning calendar, including resource allocation, capacity modeling, territory design, sales coverage, and quota setting.

  • Translate company-wide and go-to-market strategies into structured operating plans with defined objectives, owners, milestones, and performance metrics.

  • Drive cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution, ensuring clear ownership, timely delivery, and measurable outcomes.

  • At least 12 years of experience in global Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy, or a related discipline.

  • A minimum of 5 years leading multi-functional operations teams and managing managers or directors.

  • Demonstrated expertise in annual and quarterly planning, capacity modeling, territory design, quota setting, and sales coverage strategies within a large-scale B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.

  • Proven success designing and managing forecasting and deal review processes that improve conversion rates and forecast predictability.

  • Strong knowledge of pipeline inspection, quarterly business reviews, and sales performance management.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a VP, People & Business Operations based in the United States. The VP, People & Business Operations will play a key leadership role in shaping organizational effectiveness and supporting the next stage of company growth. Reporting directly to the CEO, this position oversees internal business operations and the People function, connecting workforce strategy with operational performance. You will build scalable systems for resource planning, utilization tracking, capacity management, and cross-functional accountability. Alongside this operational focus, you will lead people strategy, talent development, recruiting, performance management, and employee engagement. Working closely with executive and department leaders in a remote-first, service-based environment, you will turn business priorities and operational data into measurable improvements. This is an opportunity for a strategic, hands-on leader who enjoys building structure, improving processes, and helping teams perform at their best.

You will oversee the internal frameworks, processes, and people initiatives that enable sustainable growth. By partnering with executive leadership, Finance, and department heads, you will strengthen operational visibility, improve workforce planning, and develop a high-performing and inclusive organization.

- Strategic Business Operations & Organizational Leadership

  • Lead the planning and coordination of company-wide retreats, offsites, internal events, staff meetings, and internal communications, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and company culture.

  • Own the internal meeting cadence, including weekly team meetings, manager meetings, and all-staff sessions.

  • Develop meeting agendas, presentations, and supporting materials that reinforce priorities, accountability, follow-through, and cross-functional alignment.

  • Partner with the CEO and Finance team to prepare board reports and investor materials, taking ownership of People and Operations sections.

  • Serve as a strategic business partner to department leaders, facilitating alignment on workflows, shared challenges, resource allocation, and operational decisions.

  • Interpret utilization reports and lead capacity and team planning in collaboration with service delivery leaders.

  • Monitor progress against operational goals, identify risks, and ensure challenges are escalated and addressed proactively.

  • Establish company-wide time-tracking standards and expectations, using time data to assess utilization, workforce capacity, and service profitability.

  • Hold department leaders accountable for time-tracking standards while leaving day-to-day timesheet administration and approvals with the relevant teams.

    • - People Strategy, HR Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Provide strategic oversight of the People function, including managing and developing HR team members.

  • Directly manage the part-time Recruiting Coordinator, overseeing candidate screening, pipeline management, recruitment reporting, and hiring support.

  • Develop and implement a People strategy aligned with organizational growth, employee engagement, and an inclusive, high-performing culture.

  • Oversee recruiting, onboarding, offboarding, employee development, performance management, and employee relations.

  • Partner with executives and hiring managers to establish workforce plans, recruitment priorities, and staffing strategies.

  • Lead annual performance reviews and goal-setting processes, promoting consistency, accountability, and meaningful development.

  • Coach managers on employee relations, performance management, leadership development, and team effectiveness.

  • Oversee compensation frameworks, salary bands, benefits programs, employee policies, and HR infrastructure in partnership with Finance and external advisors.

  • Ensure employee relations matters are handled consistently, confidentially, and in compliance with company policies and applicable employment laws.

  • Act as a senior point of contact for employees on HR policies, benefits, and workplace concerns.

  • Maintain employee feedback channels, including engagement surveys and exit interviews.

  • Support organizational change management, internal communications, engagement initiatives, and culture-building programs.

  • Oversee HR administration, employee records, people systems, compliance requirements, employee training, and recurring HR processes through the People team.

  • Manage the effective use of Justworks, Culture Amp, Breezy, and Notion, including the HR Hub and company policies.

  • Partner with Finance, Legal, and external providers on employment compliance, benefits administration, and HR-related risk management.

  • Provide backup support to Finance for payroll and Justworks administration when needed.

    • - Operational Systems, Automation & Process Improvement

  • Evaluate and improve internal systems, tools, and workflows to strengthen efficiency, accountability, and scalability.

  • Own the day-to-day operational use of people systems, while collaborating with technical teams on systems outside the People and Operations remit.

  • Develop standardized operating procedures, process documentation, and clear ownership structures for recurring business activities.

  • Lead the implementation of new operational tools, policies, and workflows, including associated change management.

  • Ensure operational data is reliable, accessible, and actionable for department leaders and executive management.

  • Build repeatable processes that reduce reliance on individual knowledge and support sustainable organizational growth.

About the Role

Owns datacenter design and technical standards for Lambda’s AI infrastructure. Sets the basis of design, builds a repeatable and scalable set of reference designs, and leads the design team that delivers efficient, reliable, buildable facilities for current and next-generation GPU platforms.


What You’ll Do

Basis of design and standards

 - Own Lambda’s datacenter basis of design: electrical topology, mechanical and cooling options, and building architecture.

 - Maintain standard building modules and reference designs that scale across site sizes and capacities using a common equipment set.

 - Run design change control and manage approved deviations so designs stay consistent across regions.

AI infrastructure readiness

 - Ensure designs support current and upcoming GPU cabinet power and cooling densities, including liquid cooling and high-density row distribution.

 - Coordinate regularly with GPU, server, and networking partners so facility designs stay flexible across platform generations.

 - Drive efficiency (PUE), reliability, constructability, and cost in every design decision.

Site master planning and design delivery

 - Lead site master planning for candidate and new sites, working with Power and Site Development on power and land constraints.

 - Direct third-party architecture and engineering firms through concept, schematic, and construction documents against schedule and budget.

 - Drive prefabrication and modular delivery with Construction and the supply chain.

Equipment specification

 - Own owner-furnished equipment specifications and required equipment lists; review and approve vendor proposals and submittals.

 - Support long-lead equipment forecasting with Construction and procurement.

🌐 Commercial Acumen: You understand sales processes and can creatively translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Application Security Engineer is a hands-on software engineering role, focused on writing and shipping fixes for the hardest application and AI security problems, particularly those that cross team boundaries or involve architecture, authentication and authorisation, and that automation cannot yet safely resolve. You will work in unfamiliar codebases, root-cause the flaw, and deliver the change through code, tests and deployment, taking remediation load off engineering teams so they can stay focused on delivery. You will work closely with the teams that detect, prioritise and track vulnerabilities. As OakNorth leans heavily into agentic systems, you will also secure how AI and coding agents are built and used, and build our internal coding agent platforms so they can fix a wider range of security issues safely and at scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Write and ship fixes for complex application security vulnerabilities, including architectural weaknesses and legacy technology issues that automated remediation cannot yet handle safely.

 - Lead remediation of problems that cross team and system boundaries, making and coordinating code changes across multiple services and owners and seeing them through to production.

 - Fix authentication and authorisation flaws in code, including identity, access control, session and token handling, service-to-service trust and permission models.

 - Act as a dedicated engineering resource for security remediation, taking the fix burden off product teams so they can focus on delivery.

 - Take the output of security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, container and IaC scanning), validate findings, root-cause them in the code and implement the fix rather than only triaging.

 - Secure agentic and AI-enabled systems in code and architecture, mitigating risks from the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications such as prompt injection, excessive agent permissions, tool misuse, insecure agent-to-agent communication and unsafe handling of agent outputs.

 - Build and improve our internal coding agent platforms, including remediation agents, by contributing specialist fixes, remediation patterns, evaluation cases and feedback on where agents succeed or fail.

 - Engineer guardrails for agent-generated and human-written changes, such as least-privilege agent access, human approval points, secure defaults, shared libraries, pipeline checks and policy-as-code, so vulnerabilities do not recur.

 - Build and harden GitHub workflows and release pipelines, including GitHub Actions hardening, secrets and token handling, branch protection, dependency and supply chain controls, and security gates in CI/CD.

 - Deliver higher-risk changes safely through testing, peer review, staged rollout and rollback, in partnership with the teams that own the systems.

 - Work with the teams that detect, prioritise and track vulnerabilities to take prioritised findings through to merged fixes, and automate recurring fix types where it is safe to do so.

 - Document remediation approaches, share knowledge and coach engineers on secure design, secure coding and the safe use of AI coding agents.

 - Track remediation progress, including backlog reduction, SLA performance and risk reduction, and provide evidence for audit and regulatory requirements.
   
   

YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…

Engineering Skills

 - Full stack engineering experience across front end, back end and APIs, with proficiency in one or more languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript) and the ability to work in unfamiliar and legacy codebases.

 - Strong hands-on experience with GitHub (pull requests, code review, branch protection, code scanning) and GitHub Actions, including building and securing release pipelines.

 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms, containers and infrastructure as code.

 - Ability to review code, find vulnerabilities and implement practical, correct fixes.

Application Security Skills

 - Strong application security knowledge, including the OWASP Top 10 and common vulnerability classes such as injection, broken access control, insecure deserialization and cryptographic weaknesses.

 - Deep understanding of authentication and authorisation, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT and session handling, RBAC/ABAC models and service-to-service identity.

 - Hands-on experience interpreting application security tooling output (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, container and IaC scanning), distinguishing true and false positives and finding root cause.

 - Understanding of CI/CD and software supply chain security, including GitHub Actions risks such as untrusted input, over-privileged tokens and third-party action pinning.

AI & Agentic Security Skills

 - Day-to-day experience using coding agents such as Claude to write, review and fix code, with sound judgement on where they are reliable and where they are not.

 - Knowledge of and informed opinions on the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications and related AI security risks, including prompt injection, tool and permission abuse, data leakage and agent identity.

 - Ability to design guardrails, permission boundaries and evaluation approaches for AI agents and agent-generated changes.

 - Ability to turn manual fixes into repeatable patterns and test cases that agent platforms can use.

Remediation & Architecture Skills

 - Experience fixing architectural and design-level security issues, and making safe changes in systems with limited tests, documentation or clear ownership.

 - Ability to plan and deliver changes that span multiple teams and services, managing dependencies and risk.

 - Sound judgement on testing, rollout and rollback for higher-risk changes.

Collaboration & Communication Skills

 - Ability to work as a trusted partner to engineering teams, explaining why a fix is needed and making it easy to adopt.

 - Influence without direct authority across teams that own the affected systems, including stakeholders in different locations and time zones.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including documentation and progress reporting.

Mindset & Attributes

 - Ownership and a bias to action: comfortable taking on ambiguous, hard problems and seeing them through to resolution.

 - Pragmatic, risk-aware judgement when balancing speed of remediation against the risk of change.

 - Curiosity and continuous learning as threats and agentic technologies evolve

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Commissions & Targets Manager to own how our sales organisation is paid and how its targets are set. You'll run the commission process end to end, manage CaptivateIQ, handle complex cases, and run the quarterly target distribution for our sales reps. You'll shape our commission strategy with the Director of Revenue Operations.

You'll also be the go-to person for two experienced commission analysts. It's not a line management role, but you'll guide the team on difficult cases. Payouts depend on accurate numbers delivered on fixed deadlines, so we need someone with strong attention to detail who prioritises well in a fast-moving team.

This is an Individual Contributor role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - First 90 days: Master our commission plans, workflows, and CaptivateIQ setup, and execute your first end-of-quarter close with support from the Director.

 - First 6 months: Take full ownership of the end-of-quarter close and case escalations, and lead your first quarterly target distribution.

 - First 12 months: Partner with the Director to shape our commission strategy while optimising the processes and system configurations you inherited.



WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?


COMMISSION PROCESSES

 - Manage the end-of-quarter commission process, from data validation and plan calculations to review, approvals and payout handover. Start with the Director's oversight and take full ownership of the process within your first two quarters.

 - Define the end-of-quarter schedule: map all the activities, decide which to prioritise, identify what can be front-loaded ahead of quarter end, and build a plan that hits the deadlines and delivers quality results.

 - During the close, make quick calls and reprioritise when things go wrong, flag risks before they affect payouts, and keep the process documented and auditable.

 - Spot recurring errors and bottlenecks, and fix them at the source.


COMMISSION CASES & TEAM SUPPORT

 - Act as the escalation point for complex or disputed commission cases, supporting the two commission analysts.

 - Coach the analysts on case handling, resolve difficult cases and make clear, consistent and well-documented decisions.

 - Identify patterns in the cases raised, and use them to improve plan rules, documentation and communication.


COMMISSION SYSTEM OWNERSHIP

 - Manage our commissions system, CaptivateIQ: plan configuration, data integrations, quarterly updates and access.

 - Partner with the Sales Operations, Finance and Data team on data quality and any system changes.

 - Test and validate changes before each close, so that calculations are accurate and reproducible.


COMMISSION STRATEGY

 - Work with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the commission strategy, including plan design, rules and how they support company goals.

 - Analyse plan performance and its effect on sales behaviour, and bring a point of view on what to change.

 - Prepare the commission plan updates for each planning period and communicate them clearly to sales and finance stakeholders.


QUARTERLY TARGET DISTRIBUTION

 - Run the target setting cycle each quarter, with clear methodology and timelines, and explain the outcomes to sales leaders.

 - Make sure any outlier or special case target adjustments are handled before the targets are published.

 - Handle target questions and adjustments in a fair and consistent way.



WHAT WILL YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?

 - Strong experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Compensation or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

 - Hands-on experience running commission processes for a quota-carrying sales organisation, including end-of-quarter closes.

 - Experience administering a commissions system (CaptivateIQ or a similar tool such as Qobra) is preferred but not required.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and the discipline to deliver accurate results on fixed deadlines.

 - A strong ability to improve processes: you spot what is manual, error-prone or slow, and fix it at the source.

 - Ability to prioritise well and make fast, accurate calls in a fast-moving, deadline-driven environment.

 - Strong analytical skills. Experience setting or contributing to sales targets and quotas is a plus.

 - Good judgment and strong stakeholder management, including handling sensitive conversations about pay with sales leaders, finance and ICs.

 - Experience guiding or coaching other analysts.

 - Clear written and verbal communication in English.

 - Experience working with global or multi-region teams is a plus.

We're looking for a Commissions & Targets Manager to own how our sales organisation is paid and how its targets are set. You'll run the commission process end to end, manage CaptivateIQ, handle complex cases, and run the quarterly target distribution for our sales reps. You'll shape our commission strategy with the Director of Revenue Operations.

You'll also be the go-to person for two experienced commission analysts. It's not a line management role, but you'll guide the team on difficult cases. Payouts depend on accurate numbers delivered on fixed deadlines, so we need someone with strong attention to detail who prioritises well in a fast-moving team.

This is an Individual Contributor role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - First 90 days: Master our commission plans, workflows, and CaptivateIQ setup, and execute your first end-of-quarter close with support from the Director.

 - First 6 months: Take full ownership of the end-of-quarter close and case escalations, and lead your first quarterly target distribution.

 - First 12 months: Partner with the Director to shape our commission strategy while optimising the processes and system configurations you inherited.



WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?


COMMISSION PROCESSES

 - Manage the end-of-quarter commission process, from data validation and plan calculations to review, approvals and payout handover. Start with the Director's oversight and take full ownership of the process within your first two quarters.

 - Define the end-of-quarter schedule: map all the activities, decide which to prioritise, identify what can be front-loaded ahead of quarter end, and build a plan that hits the deadlines and delivers quality results.

 - During the close, make quick calls and reprioritise when things go wrong, flag risks before they affect payouts, and keep the process documented and auditable.

 - Spot recurring errors and bottlenecks, and fix them at the source.


COMMISSION CASES & TEAM SUPPORT

 - Act as the escalation point for complex or disputed commission cases, supporting the two commission analysts.

 - Coach the analysts on case handling, resolve difficult cases and make clear, consistent and well-documented decisions.

 - Identify patterns in the cases raised, and use them to improve plan rules, documentation and communication.


COMMISSION SYSTEM OWNERSHIP

 - Manage our commissions system, CaptivateIQ: plan configuration, data integrations, quarterly updates and access.

 - Partner with the Sales Operations, Finance and Data team on data quality and any system changes.

 - Test and validate changes before each close, so that calculations are accurate and reproducible.


COMMISSION STRATEGY

 - Work with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the commission strategy, including plan design, rules and how they support company goals.

 - Analyse plan performance and its effect on sales behaviour, and bring a point of view on what to change.

 - Prepare the commission plan updates for each planning period and communicate them clearly to sales and finance stakeholders.


QUARTERLY TARGET DISTRIBUTION

 - Run the target setting cycle each quarter, with clear methodology and timelines, and explain the outcomes to sales leaders.

 - Make sure any outlier or special case target adjustments are handled before the targets are published.

 - Handle target questions and adjustments in a fair and consistent way.



WHAT WILL YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?

 - Strong experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Compensation or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

 - Experience administering a commissions system (CaptivateIQ or a similar tool such as Qobra) is preferred but not required.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and the discipline to deliver accurate results on fixed deadlines.

 - A strong ability to improve processes: you spot what is manual, error-prone or slow, and fix it at the source.

 - Ability to prioritise well and make fast, accurate calls in a fast-moving, deadline-driven environment.

 - Strong analytical skills. Experience setting or contributing to sales targets and quotas is a plus.

 - Good judgment and strong stakeholder management, including handling sensitive conversations about pay with sales leaders, finance and ICs.

 - Experience guiding or coaching other analysts.

 - Clear written and verbal communication in English.

 - Experience working with global or multi-region teams is a plus.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

 - First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling.

 - First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations.

 


WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?


RUN COMPLEX MODELLING & ANALYSIS

 - Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers.

 - Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation.

 - Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language.

 - Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Job Title: Head of AEO/SEO

Reporting to: Senior Director of Growth Marketing

Location: London



About The Role:

Perk is hiring a Head of SEO and AEO  to own how buyers find us organically: our website, search (SEO) and answer-engine visibility (AEO) across all LLMs.

You will lead a small, senior team and run SEO and AEO as a revenue channel, not a traffic channel. Success is measured in pipeline and sign-ups influenced by these channels, and in how often Perk is the cited, recommended answer when buyers research travel and spend management. This isn’t just a strategic role, the candidate also needs to be hands on with managing SEO and AEO strategy and performance, delivering on a content roadmap, working with the agency and web team on testing, technical monitoring and reporting, tracking of core business metrics. and collaborating with PR, Social, Content and PMM on off-site and on-site / product content as required.

You will be accountable for performance driven by these channels and for making sure both the strategy and the way we measure it keep pace as search changes. You will evolve and develop the strategy as AI continues to reshape search, while also having a clear view of where search is heading and the credibility to bring others with you.

What you'll own

 - SEO: technical health, content strategy, programmatic and landing-page systems, internal linking, authority and link earning, managing and partnering with an inhouse SEO manager and external agency on content development and optimisations.

 - AEO: visibility and citation in AI answers and AI search: entity and brand presence, structured data, answer-shaped content, third-party sources that models trust, and measurement of share of voice.

 - Measurement: attribution of organic and AI-referred traffic to pipeline and revenue, with Marketing Ops and Data.

 - Experiment and adopt what works. Test new approaches early, including AI-assisted workflows, and scale what proves its value.

 - Report with clarity. Give leadership a clear, consistent read on organic and AI search performance and what it means for the business.

 - 7-10 years in SEO, ideally in B2B SaaS or in an agency environment, with a track record of growing organic pipeline, not just traffic.

 - A clear point of view on AEO and the future of search. You can say what is changing, what is hype and what you would do about it.. You will need to be an AI native/AI fluent marketing leader.

 - Hands-on AEO experience: measuring and improving brand visibility and citations across AI platforms, with a working view of what influences them.

 - Strong technical SEO fundamentals, including schema, site architecture, performance and international structure.

 - Experience delivering SEO across multiple markets.

 - Strong analytical skills, with experience turning search and AI visibility data into clear insight and recommendations.

 - Experience managing external agency partners and budgets.

 - Experience managing or mentoring a small team.

Nice to Have:

 - Experience in travel, fintech or expense management.

 - Experience building AI-assisted SEO workflows.

 - Digital PR or link-building experience.

 - Familiarity with headless CMS setups.

 - A strategic thinker and a recognised voice on the future of search and AEO, with views grounded in hands-on work that you can defend with confidence.

Position Summary:
Reporting to the Senior Director, Finance Operations, the Director of Finance, Billing to Cash leads a team of high-performing managers and individual contributors to ensure the billing-to-cash process is frictionless for customers and maximizes cash collections. This highly impactful role leads a high-volume Billing to Cash department with more than $700M in annual collections. Oversee the effectiveness and efficiency of billing, collections, escalation management, and account resolution across the Accounts Receivable portfolio for all business units.

Drive collections efficiency through payment automation, including ACH adoption, and optimized billing frequency.

Develop and implement a customer risk management framework, policies, and procedures to maximize cash flow and minimize bad debt risk, including credit risk, bankruptcies, unclaimed property, and collateral consents.
Serve as the Finance gatekeeper for extending credit to customers with poor payment history or elevated credit risk, while partnering with Sales and Commercial teams to structure terms responsibly and unlock revenue opportunities.
Partner with Treasury to provide reliable cash flow forecasts.
Partner with controllership and revenue accounting to support timely and accurate financial reporting and period-end close.
Oversee billing validations to support invoice accuracy and timely customer delivery.
Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve upstream issues, optimize billing operations, and minimize billing issues.
Develop a high-performing, tech-forward team that can solve issues end to end and serve as subject matter experts in their areas.
Perform other duties as assigned by management to support overall team objectives.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Extensive expertise in Order-to-Cash processes and best practices.
Credit control and statutory knowledge, including Anti-Money Laundering and Escheatment.
Strong leadership skills, including team building and motivation, transformation, and organization design.
Demonstrated commitment to PointClickCare's core values: People, Passion, and Performance.

Redis Flex lets customers run datasets larger than available RAM by storing data across memory and flash. As access patterns shift, Flex has to decide which data to keep in RAM and when to move data between tiers so applications can keep responding quickly.



As a Senior Software Engineer on the Flex team, you’ll work across Redis core and the Speedb storage engine. You’ll shape how data is placed, evicted, and persisted, balancing memory cost, latency, and durability so Redis Enterprise customers can grow their datasets and keep performance predictable.




THE ROLE

 - Improve how Redis Flex places, moves, and evicts data across RAM and flash. Measure how those changes affect latency, throughput, and RAM usage.

 - Solve problems involving persistence, consistency, memory management, and concurrency across both storage tiers.

 - Build benchmarks, profile demanding workloads, and diagnose performance bottlenecks.

 - Contribute to technical designs and code reviews, and own your changes from design through production.

THE ROLE

Leading financial institutions like Carlyle Group, KKR, Ares, and BBVA use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive portfolio decarbonization.

We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically minded individual to join our Sustainability Data Advisory team in London, with a focus on financial institutions. You'll join a small team that operates like a startup within a startup at Watershed, working with some of the world's leading asset managers, private equity firms, banks, and insurers to accelerate their sustainability strategies.

You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform. You'll help customers measure financed emissions and use insights from their footprint to inform reporting and decision-making.

The role & impact

You will run the Networks team in Cloud Capabilities, the group that looks after Xero's cloud network, DNS and CDN. You will set the team's direction, deliver against our Cloud Capabilities goals for the year, grow and support your engineers, and balance roadmap work with support requests and incidents. You will work closely with Product, Security and the other Cloud Capabilities teams.

The Networks team underpins connectivity, name resolution and content delivery for every Xero product, so your work shapes reliability, security and cost at global scale. Together with your team, you will shape a multi-year network strategy across AWS and edge providers, with real ownership and a clear mandate to modernise. It is a chance to Go Further in running critical infrastructure your way.

The team & how they connect

You will join a team of seven engineers at a range of levels, reporting to the Head of Engineering, Cloud Capabilities. The team works in fortnightly sprints, shares a support rotation and reviews incidents without blame. Written decisions and open technical debate are part of how we Go Together.

 - Getting to know our network architecture, risks and support load, and building trust with the team and partners.

 - Agreeing a prioritised roadmap and ways of working with the Head of Engineering. 

 - Shaping a multi-year network plan across AWS and edge providers, including DNS and CDN. 

 - Reducing reliability and tech-debt risks while sharing support and incident work fairly across the team.

Where and how you can work

This is a permanent role based in Melbourne or Sydney. Our Boost days (think free lunch, coffee, breakfast) are a chance to connect, recharge and learn from one another.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - Your background includes guiding engineering teams that run production infrastructure, from hiring to performance conversations and career growth.

 - You bring a solid grounding in cloud networking (VPC, routing, DNS, CDN and load balancing) to support your team well and Go Further.

 - You are comfortable setting direction, delivering against roadmaps and OKRs, and handling planned and unplanned work side by side.

 - You Go Bold by modernising critical infrastructure with care, weighing up priorities and trade-offs as you go.

 - You Go Together by building trust with stakeholders and explaining your thinking clearly in writing. 

 - A cloud certification such as AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, or formal management training, would be a bonus.

Accountants and bookkeepers are an important part of the Xero ecosystem, and this role shapes how we recognise and reward them at every stage of their journey with us. This isn’t a campaign role. You’ll own a live, global platform and be able to draw a straight line from your work to partner engagement, tier progression and extra revenue. Product-led loyalty is new for Xero, so you’ll Go Bold by shaping it rather than inheriting it, and share what you learn with senior leaders along the way.

You’ll join the Accountant and Bookkeeper (AB) Journey team, which looks after how accountants and bookkeepers experience Xero, from first onboarding through to growth and expansion. You’ll work closely with four Journey Managers, each responsible for a stage of that journey, as well as regional marketing, finance  and go-to-market teams. The team is curious and loves to test and learn, with a monthly readout where wins and lessons are shared openly.




INITIALLY, THE ROLE WILL FOCUS ON

 - Getting to know our Salesforce partner loyalty platform: what is live today, how data flows, and where improvements will help most.

 - Building working relationships with Journey Managers and regional marketers, and agreeing one or two loyalty opportunities for each stage.

 - Setting a starting point for engagement, tiers and points-led actions, so the impact of every change is easy to see.

 - Launching a first test-and-learn points promotion tied to a clear milestone, then building towards a global promotions calendar with regional versions.
   
   


WHERE AND HOW YOU CAN WORK

This role is based in the US, and you'll work with colleagues across regions and time zones. We welcome candidates based near one of our offices, and we would also consider a remote US team member for this opportunity.




HERE ARE SOME OF THE THINGS WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You bring hands-on experience with a loyalty or incentive platform, ideally Salesforce, from rule configuration through to testing and troubleshooting.

 - A track record of shaping loyalty, reseller or partner programmes that lifted adoption, engagement, revenue or tier progression.

 - Comfort with data, so you can define success measures, set up A/B tests and holdouts, and explain the results in plain language.

 - Skill in adapting a global programme for different regions and time zones while keeping the whole thing coherent.

 - You Go Together with Journey Managers, regional teams and senior leaders, using clear writing to build trust and make the case for change.
